the combination of morphology and kinetic parameters in a logistic regression analysis yields the best results.

MR imaging of small lesions is feasible, and that the incorporation of quantitative MRI derived parameters is beneficial.

the addition of quantitative MR parameters improves the diagnostic accuracy of breast MRI in the differential diagnosis between benign and malignant sub 1-cm lesions.
